name: codex-hud
description: Local dynamic HUD for the active Codex CLI session

interface.shortDescription: Show live Codex session telemetry beside Codex
interface.longDescription: Adds an opt-in, local-only HUD for the current Codex account and session. It uses eight base rows and expands dynamically to at most twenty-four rows — one per running subagent plus Todo detail rows. macOS standalone Ghostty uses a native split; tmux panes remain the fallback for nested tmux and non-Ghostty terminals. It displays official-parity context pressure, tool and subagent activity (model and reasoning effort), Todo progress, cache usage, estimated API-equivalent cost, quotas, and elapsed session time.
